rationale: Move the Bend compiler pin from a49524265bdfa5753a4bf38e25f0574a705dd868 to upstream main ff7a40cc9070a34c78399ecd2bbe46a044ad9b4b (both Bend 2.0.25, Bun 1.4.2 unchanged). Upstream changed a README link, EFFECTS.md prose for io_node/io_wait_on, and one compiler line that resets the probe list for each book compiled in one process (bendlang/bend#976), which this project's loader does. Frozen manifests stay byte-identical; freeze.mjs and freeze-v2.mjs resolve their recorded hashes through this reviewed amendment chain. Every v1, v2, mutation, library and browser-build gate passed under the new pin before this amendment was recorded; no law, proof, implementation, fixture or reference byte changed.

toolchain.target: browser JavaScript; native parallelism not yet measured

bend2/TOOLCHAIN.json.reason: bendCommit moved to ff7a40cc9070a34c78399ecd2bbe46a044ad9b4b; repository, version, Bun version, runtime package and telemetry setting unchanged.

bend2/tools/freeze-v2.mjs.reason: verifyV2 compares each frozen file hash after resolving it through the amendment chain (matchesFrozen); evidence checks and the create path stay exact.

bend2/tools/freeze.mjs.reason: verifyFreeze compares each recorded hash after resolving it through the amendment chain (matchesFrozen); create path and all other checks unchanged.
